description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}.
Cast a copy of Pack a Punch from exile by paying {1}{W}{R}, targeting Tethmos High Priest, unpreparing Kirol.
When you cast that spell, Tethmos High Priest triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Diamond Lion leaves your graveyard, Kirol triggers, becoming prepared.
Pack a Punch resolves, causing you to mill a card, put two +1/+1 counters onto Tethmos High Priest, and give it trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kirol, History Buff // Pack a Punch
